workflows.quote: You will be prompted to set up two-step verification to keep your personal and financial information secure. Signing into your portal will periodically require both a password, as well as a security code, that will be sent via your preferred method.

workflows.label: Vendor team invitations
workflows.quote: You can invite a user via email and once they accept your invitation, they will have access to any of your assigned work orders and can invite other users.

workflows.label: Vendor team revocation
workflows.quote: You can also remove user access from your account via the Delete button. Invited users will also be able to remove other invited users.

workflows.label: Vendor payment preference
workflows.quote: Once you’ve set up two-step verification, you can confirm your payment preference and enter your payment information.

workflows.label: Vendor instant pay
workflows.quote: Please note that Instant Pay may not be available or provided by all property managers.

workflows.label: Vendor payment history PDF
workflows.quote: Click View Details to download the PDF version of the payment details.

workflows.label: Vendor compliance originals
workflows.quote: Any time your client requests compliance documents needing attention, you will receive an email notification. The email will prompt you to upload an updated PDF version of the document in the portal.

workflows.label: Accept or decline assigned work
workflows.quote: When you receive a new job in Vendor Portal, you may need to Accept or Decline the job.

workflows.label: Assigned work order search
workflows.quote: Search Bar: Use the search bar to enter the work order number (e.g., #250-1) or the property address at any time. Click on any result to navigate to the job's details page.

workflows.label: Requested estimate status
workflows.quote: Needs Estimate: You need to submit an estimate of this job

workflows.label: Customer estimate review
workflows.quote: Estimated: The customer needs to review your estimate

workflows.label: Competing repair estimates
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: Property managers have the option to request estimates from multiple vendors for each job. If you are selected, you will receive the job details in the “Estimates” Work Order Group in the Vendor Portal.

workflows.label: Vendor estimated cost submission
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: You will be able to submit an estimated cost, which will be submitted back to the property manager. If you are approved, this will move to the “In Progress” Work Order Group in the Vendor Portal and you will be notified via email.Adding a Note

workflows.label: Work order PDF
workflows.quote: You can download a PDF containing the details of the work order by clicking the Download PDF button at the top of the Details Page.

workflows.label: Resident availability scheduling
workflows.quote: Select any time and click Schedule Job to schedule the job. Your customer and the resident will be notified.

workflows.label: Appointment reminders
workflows.quote: We will send the resident a reminder 24 hours before the scheduled time.

workflows.label: Upload vendor invoice
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: If you have another tool you use to create your invoice, you can upload it to Vendor Portal and your customer will receive it.

workflows.label: Create itemized invoice
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: You can create a new invoice from scratch by creating billable items.

workflows.label: Edit vendor invoice
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: You can make changes to the invoice by clicking Edit and by clicking the three dots (Kebab) icon:

workflows.label: Work notes and photos
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: Notes allow you to provide messages and photos about the job to your customer. To add notes to your work order, click the Notes button at the bottom of a Work Order.

workflows.label: Vendor completion submission
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: After completing the job, you can tell your customer that you have finished by clicking Work Done. This will change the status to Under Review or Needs Invoice if you have not added an invoice.

workflows.label: Resident account activation
workflows.quote: You'll receive an account activation email or text message from your property management company. Click Activate Now in the email, or tap the link in the email or text message to establish a strong password to activate your account.

workflows.label: Native resident mobile access
workflows.quote: Download the mobile app to stay logged into FolioSpace. Make payments, submit maintenance requests, and review important documents 24/7.

workflows.label: Resident two-factor authentication
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Account Profile tab. In the 2FA section, check Enable Two Factor Authentication, and hit save.

workflows.label: Account password recovery
workflows.quote: 3. An email with instructions to reset your password will be sent. Emails will only be sent if there is an active existing account. If the email is not in your inbox, please be sure to check spam for @appfolio.com emails.

workflows.label: Current and future charges
workflows.quote: Once logged in, you will land on the Home tab where you can view your current balance owed and details of current and future charges broken down by month.

workflows.label: One-time resident payment
workflows.quote: Click Pay Now to make a one-time payment.

workflows.label: Full or partial payment policy
workflows.quote: Next, choose to make your payment in full or to edit the amount. If online payments are required to be made in full, the payment amount will not be editable, and you will have the option of paying either the Balance Due, which includes past and current bills, or the Full Balance, which includes past, current, and any upcoming bills, including unposted, recurring bills.

workflows.label: Payment submission confirmation
workflows.quote: Once you have verified all your payment information, click Make This Payment Now. You will receive a confirmation email once the payment is successfully submitted, although this does not mean it has cleared your bank account yet. If you do not receive a confirmation email, you did not fully complete all necessary steps to submit the payment.

workflows.label: Autopay creation
workflows.quote: On the Home or Payments tab, click Set Up Autopay to create an automatically recurring payment

workflows.label: Autopay cancellation
workflows.section: How Do I Delete My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: You can stop any future auto payments from processing by navigating to the Payments tab and locating the Scheduled Payments block. Select Delete on the auto payment you have created. Please note that you cannot delete payments created by your roommates.

workflows.label: Skip one autopay
workflows.section: How Do I Skip My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: To skip the next month's payment, navigate to the Payments tab and locate the Scheduled Payments block. Click Skip this payment under the auto payment you have created (you cannot skip payments created by your roommates). The auto payment will resume after the skipped month.

workflows.label: Autopay amount edit
workflows.section: How Do I Change the Amount of My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Payments tab and locate the Scheduled Payments block. Click Edit under the auto payment you have created (you cannot edit payments created by your roommates). Update the amount of the payment then click Save at the bottom of the page.

workflows.label: Autopay bank or card change
workflows.section: How Do I Change the Payment Information of My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: Update the bank account or card information on file then click Save at the bottom of the page. If you are changing your auto payment from a credit and debit card to an eCheck (or vice versa), then you’ll need to delete your auto payment then create a new one.

workflows.label: Autopay maximum limit
workflows.section: How Do I Change My Auto Payment Maximum Limit?
workflows.quote: If you have an existing pay-in-full auto payment, you will be required to set a maximum limit in order to prevent payments of an unexpected amount. If you would like to change this amount, navigate to the Payments tab and locate the Scheduled Payments block. Click edit under the auto payment you have created. Update the maximum amount and then click Save at the bottom of the page. Updating the maximum limit can be done at any time.

workflows.label: Resident account ledger
workflows.quote: Click the Payments tab, then click View full account ledger to see a detailed account of all charges and payments posted to your account. Please contact your property manager if you have any questions about the transactions displayed.

workflows.label: Delete saved payment method
workflows.section: Can I Delete My Saved Bank Account or Card?
workflows.quote: Yes, you can delete a saved bank account or card. Click the Account Profile tab and locate the Saved Payment Methods block. Under the saved payment method details, click the red Delete, then click Yes, Delete to confirm.

workflows.label: Retail cash payslip
workflows.section: Where Can I Find My Electronic Cash Payment Slip?
workflows.quote: You can find the electronic cash payment slip by navigating to the Payments tab, then clicking Download Payslip from the Electronic Cash Payments block. Alternatively, you may find your payslip as an attachment in your Shared Document tab.

workflows.label: Electronic lease signatures
workflows.section: How Do I Sign My Lease Electronically?
workflows.quote: Your electronic lease will appear as soon as you enter your move-in checklist in FolioSpace. Read through the document carefully and select the first initial line you see. You will be prompted to enter your full name and initials to create your electronic signature. As you read through your lease, click every initial and signature line that you see to provide your electronic signature until you have reached the end of the document.

workflows.label: Electronic renewal signatures
workflows.section: How Do I Renew My Lease Electronically?
workflows.quote: If you received an email that you have a lease renewal offer in FolioSpace, you can review the lease details on the Home tab. Review the offer(s) in the banner, then click View to begin signing the renewal offer of your choice.

workflows.label: Change electronic signature
workflows.section: How Do I Update My Electronic Signature for Signing Documents?
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Account Profile tab, then click Edit Electronic Signature in the Signature block. Enter your legal full name and initials, then click Save.

workflows.label: Move-in utility setup
workflows.section: How Do I Set Up My Utilities in FolioSpace?
workflows.quote: When you first activate your FolioSpace account, you will be welcomed to a move-in checklist that guides you through your key move-in tasks. If your property manager has selected utilities that you are responsible for, you will see them listed in the Set Up Utilities step. You may also choose to upload a document or manually enter details to confirm.

workflows.label: Utility concierge referral
workflows.section: How Do I Get Help With Utilities?
workflows.quote: Your property manager may offer a free Move-In Concierge to help with utilities and home services set up. The Concierge service is offered by AppFolio and staffed by professionals who can help connect you with your required gas, water, and electric providers. They can also help you find and sign up for internet, TV, and home security packages in your area.

workflows.label: Resident contact updates
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Account Profile tab and locate the Contact Information block. Here you can update the email address you use to log into your account, the phone number, mailing address, and vehicle information your property manager has on file for you.

workflows.label: Resident account deletion
workflows.section: I No Longer Rent With This Property Manager. How Do I Delete My Account?
workflows.quote: Please contact your property manager and ask them to delete the login information associated with your account.

workflows.label: Telephone maintenance intake
workflows.quote: The Smart Maintenance Contact Center uses intelligent AI to automate responses to residents 24/7 — no matter the time of day or night, so your team can focus on running your business. Long gone are the days of you or your residents having to fill out stacks of paperwork if something breaks. With multiple forms of communication, residents can easily submit a text message, make a quick call, or use their online resident portal to get started. From there, the request is received and the resident gets an AI-aided response within minutes to follow up and determine the urgency of the issue.

workflows.quote: The Smart Maintenance Contact Center uses intelligent AI to automate responses to residents 24/7 — no matter the time of day or night, so your team can focus on running your business. workflows.label: Maintenance emergency troubleshooting and preferred-vendor dispatch
workflows.quote: “Smart Maintenance monitors all work orders that come in, day or night, to see if it’s an emergency and helps residents troubleshoot or decide any next steps to ensure the property is not being damaged or that there are no health and safety issues. Then, the system contacts our preferred vendors, a choice that we put within the system. So ultimately, Smart Maintenance can take that work order and handle the situation without contacting anyone on our team. Right now with the staffing shortage that is going on nationwide, it’s just one extra support that you can have for those team members so they aren’t working overtime every single week.”

workflows.label: Combined report builder with drill-down

workflows.label: Rent roll column customization and saved export

workflows.quote: Once selected, a new screen will show the typical columns that are contained in the rent roll — Unit, Tenant, Status, Rent, Deposit, Lease Start, Lease End, etc. Below this, the user will see a section for adding columns from other reports. As long as the data is in the system, it can be added to your customized report. So, let’s say you want to add residents’ contact information to a current Rent Roll. You could do so by finding their phone number and email address in this section and adding it to the base report. This new report can then be exported or saved for future use.

workflows.label: Vacancy duration and trailing owner income reports
workflows.section: Customizing your reports in AppFolio Property Manager
workflows.quote: This is just one very basic example of the capabilities of Report Builder. Want to find out how long a unit has been vacant? Does an owner want to see a trailing five-year income statement? You can now get those insights in seconds, without needing to export and manually manipulate reports. With Report Builder, it’s easier than ever to make better business decisions and deliver the insights your stakeholders need. And the easier it is to extract data and create reports, the more efficient your operation can be.

workflows.quote: Listing and Un-Listing Units

workflows.label: Workflow progress and reassignment
workflows.quote: Track the status of all your workflow processes from within one view. Review what’s in-progress, or behind schedule, and easily reassign steps to staff within a few clicks.

workflows.label: Custom workflow blueprints
workflows.quote: Quickly and easily develop workflow processes from pre-built templates and edit a wide range of process types to fit your specific company's needs.

workflows.label: Event date and schedule workflow triggers
workflows.quote: Our workflow management autotriggers instantly initiate workflows to begin when tagged events occur within AppFolio, on relative dates, or on a specific schedule.

workflows.label: Staff change audit center
workflows.quote: Gain enhanced visibility into tracked changes made by your staff within AppFolio. View an itemized history of activity and edits throughout AppFolio, when they occurred and who performed them.

workflows.label: Custom user roles
workflows.quote: Create additional user roles specific to your business’ terminologies and structure.

workflows.label: Warehouse and report data exports
workflows.quote: Export AppFolio reports and data into downloaded files or your data warehouse.

workflows.label: Page audit logs and reversions
workflows.quote: All changes made to specific pages will be tracked, giving you peace of mind to catch mistakes and quickly revert them when needed.

workflows.label: Staff two-factor authentication
workflows.quote: Two-factor authentication defends against phishers, fraudsters, and unwanted users from accessing your sensitive financial and personal data in AppFolio.

workflows.label: Owner invitation activation
workflows.quote: Click the Activate Now button in the email from your property management company to begin setting up the Owner Portal

workflows.label: Owner email confirmation
workflows.quote: Now, navigate back to your email inbox to find this activation link and click Confirm my email.

workflows.label: Owner password and two-factor authentication
workflows.section: Create a Password & Set Up Two-Factor Authentication
workflows.quote: To keep your personal and financial information secure, your Owner Portal has an additional layer of security with two-factor authentication. This means signing into your portal will periodically require both a password and as well as a security code that will be sent via your preferred method.

workflows.label: Owner remembered-device sign-in
workflows.section: Create a Password & Set Up Two-Factor Authentication
workflows.quote: Additionally, you can check a box that remembers the device you’re on for 30 days, which will automatically log you into your Owner Portal without having to verify your email and password again.

workflows.label: Owner phone verification migration
workflows.quote: Next, you will be prompted to add a phone number with the following screen. You can set up phone verification via SMS or phone call. You can enter your mobile or landline number. We suggest providing the primary mobile number you use, one that is accessible all the time.

workflows.label: Owner property income dashboard
workflows.quote: Total Income: All receipts against your properties.

workflows.label: Owner paid-bill expense dashboard
workflows.quote: Total Expense: All paid bills against your properties

workflows.label: Owner contribution dashboard
workflows.quote: ‘Your Contribution’ Total - The lump sum of all contributions you have made towards your properties

workflows.label: Owner disbursement dashboard
workflows.quote: ‘Your Disbursement’ Total - The lump sum of all distributions made to you from the property management company

workflows.label: Owner latest published statement packet
workflows.quote: Most Recent Packet - The most recent packet shared with you by your property management company (click ‘See All’ to see all statements shared)

workflows.label: Owner occupancy dashboard
workflows.quote: Occupancy percentage - The percentage of your active units that are occupied vs. vacant as of today’s date. (clicking ‘See More’ will take you to the Properties page for more information)

workflows.label: Owner rent collection dashboard
workflows.quote: Rent Collection - The total amount of rent charged vs. rent paid month-to-date

workflows.label: Owner income transaction drill-down
workflows.quote: Income breakdown - Each individual transaction that makes up the total shown at the top in Total Income

workflows.label: Owner expense transaction drill-down
workflows.quote: Expense breakdown - Each individual transaction that makes up the total shown at the top in Total Expense

workflows.label: Owner entity and property dashboard filters
workflows.quote: By default, your dashboard will show you all active properties. However, if you would like to see specific properties or entities click the dropdown in the top left corner of your dashboard and choose either a specific entity (if your email address is affiliated with more than one entity) or choose a specific property under ownership. When you choose a different item from the dropdown your dashboard will automatically filter to show you details for the selected.

workflows.label: Owner dashboard widget selection
workflows.quote: Click ‘Select Widgets’ to add or remove portions of the dashboard

workflows.label: Owner dashboard widget arrangement
workflows.quote: Once you have your desired widgets, you can drag and drop them to different areas of the dashboard.

workflows.label: Owner dashboard widget sizing
workflows.quote: Use the bottom right-hand corner of any widget to resize as desired

workflows.label: Owner dashboard preferences across devices
workflows.quote: The next time you log in, you will see the dashboard as you have personalized it - no matter what device you are using.

workflows.label: Owner dashboard default restoration
workflows.quote: If at any point you want to start over, there is a ‘Restore to Default’ option in the top left of Customize mode that will set your dashboard back to default settings.

workflows.label: Owner live report generation
workflows.quote: The reports tab gives you the ability to run reports in real-time for your active properties. To run a report, follow these steps:

workflows.label: Owner report property and date filters
workflows.quote: You will be brought to a ‘Customize’ screen where you can select the desired property and applicable date ranges (if you want to see all properties, don’t select any).

workflows.label: Owner report text search
workflows.quote: Find in Report allows you to search for specific words or numbers within the report

workflows.label: Owner portrait and landscape report PDF
workflows.quote: Print to PDF will give you the ability to print to PDF in either portrait or landscape view

workflows.label: Owner Excel and CSV report export
workflows.quote: Actions allows you to export the report to Excel or CSV

workflows.label: Owner report data refresh
workflows.quote: Refresh will update the report with any new data, if available

workflows.label: Owner report column customization
workflows.quote: Customize will bring you back to the original customize screen to change your filters or columns, when applicable

workflows.label: Owner active-property views across entities
workflows.quote: The properties tab is home to all actively owned properties for any entity tied to your e-mail address. Not only can you quickly see the address but you also have a table with the following information:

workflows.label: Owner property reserve display
workflows.quote: If you have a reserve on the property, the amount will appear to the right of the address. For properties without a reserve amount, nothing will appear.

workflows.label: Former-owner active-property suppression
workflows.quote: Your properties tab will only show you information for properties that are active as of today’s date. If your ownership ended on a specific property, you will not see that property on the Properties page.

workflows.label: Owner published packet download
workflows.quote: Statements: View or download published statements and reports. Packets are ordered by date with the most recent at the top and will be grouped under the owner of record. Click Download Packet to download the packet to your computer or mobile device.

workflows.label: Owner shared original download
workflows.quote: Documents: Any files your property manager has shared will be stored here. Click the name of the file to view it online, or click Download to save it to your computer.

workflows.label: Owner bank account change
workflows.quote: 4. On this page, you can update or change your Routing Number, Account Number, and Account Type. When completed, check off the box to agree to the terms and finally, click Save Changes.

workflows.label: Owner bank-change staff notification
workflows.quote: 5. Your property manager will then receive an email notification letting them know you have updated your bank account settings.

workflows.label: Owner card and ACH contributions
workflows.quote: If enabled, you can make secure monetary contributions via credit and debit card or eCheck (ACH) to the property of your choice.

workflows.label: Owner contribution fee preview
workflows.quote: Select a property, enter an amount ($15,000 max), select a payment method, and click Continue. Transaction fees apply when paying online. You are notified of the fee amount before you submit the payment.

workflows.label: Separate owner contribution and fee transactions
workflows.quote: Note: The contribution and fee will be processed as separate transactions. The base contribution appears on your statement as a transaction from the management company and the fee will appear as a transaction from AppFolio.

workflows.label: Owner contribution confirmation
workflows.quote: You will receive an email notification if your payment was successfully submitted. Print or save the confirmation page or email for your records if necessary.

workflows.label: Owner multi-entity statement packets
workflows.quote: Access to your Owner Portal is based upon your email address. As long as each record in your property manager's database has the same email address entered, information for all properties should be contained within one portal. Scroll down the page to see separate packets for each entity. If you still cannot find the correct packets, please contact your property manager.

workflows.label: Unified maintenance intake coordination and feedback
workflows.quote: Smart automation powered by built-in agentic AI handles everything from intake and follow-up to vendor coordination and feedback, freeing your team to concentrate on providing exceptional service and maximizing profit.

workflows.label: Property management workflow automation
workflows.quote: Performance management workflow automation tools allow you to offload tasks from your to-do list so you can focus on winning new customers, executing multi-year strategies, and surpassing your competition.

workflows.label: Custom property-management fields
workflows.quote: Custom Fields

workflows.label: Property-management database API
workflows.quote: Database API

workflows.label: Accounting budget forecasts
workflows.quote: Accounting Performer (Budgeting)

workflows.label: Resident exact payment date amount and fee review
workflows.quote: Review the Payment Date and Payment Balance information for accuracy. A transaction fee will also be displayed.

workflows.label: Manager-controlled online payment enablement
workflows.quote: If you see a message stating you cannot make online payments, please contact your property manager as this is a service they can choose to offer their residents.

workflows.label: Resident bank card and Apple Pay method selection
workflows.quote: Select your preferred payment method: eCheck (direct withdrawal from bank account), or Credit and debit card (Apple Pay or direct). You can then enter the associated payment information and click Continue.

workflows.label: Fixed or outstanding-balance autopay starting date
workflows.quote: Give the payment a name, select whether you want to pay a fixed amount or your outstanding balance, choose the payment start date.

workflows.label: Processed autopay stop-payment referral
workflows.quote: If you have already received a confirmation email that your payment has been processed this month when it shouldn’t have, you’ll need to reach out to your bank or credit card provider to issue a stop payment.

workflows.label: Transaction fee exclusion from autopay cap
workflows.quote: No, transaction fees are not included in the maximum limit set on pay-in-full auto payments.

workflows.label: Payment transaction fee disclosure
workflows.quote: Transaction fees apply when paying online. You are notified of the fee amount before you submit the payment.

workflows.label: Certified-funds-only retail cash payment
workflows.quote: Your property manager can provide you with a reusable PaySlip with a barcode to use when making cash payments at participating locations. The cost to make an electronic cash payment is $4.99 per transaction. Transaction limits apply, please refer to the top of your PaySlip for more details.

workflows.label: Private payment details hidden from property staff
workflows.quote: No, your property manager cannot see any of the payment information you have saved or have previously entered.

workflows.label: Personal and business bank payment sources
workflows.quote: You can use a personal or business checking or savings account. Make sure to enter the routing and account number exactly as they appear on your checks and confirm the account has sufficient funds before paying.

workflows.label: Electronic check fraud-protection payment limits
workflows.quote: You are shown the maximum you can pay while making an Online Payment in FolioSpace. If you receive the error message, "Your payment amount is too large. Please contact your property manager, or try again later," you may have hit a limit we put in place for fraud protection. Please ask your property manager to contact AppFolio about the issue.

workflows.label: Card limits preserved across charge and unit changes
workflows.quote: Please note, if your recurring charge amount increases or if you start paying for a new unit in the same FolioSpace account, the max allowed for a credit or debit card payment will not change. This only applies to payments made via credit or debit card, so you can switch to eCheck to pay a larger amount in one payment.

workflows.label: Separate payment and provider-fee bank descriptors
workflows.quote: eCheck payments appear as "[your management company]." Credit or debit card payments appear as "AF* [your management company]." Any applicable fee will appear separately as APPFOLIO_TXNFEE.

workflows.label: Resident receipt and confirmation retrieval
workflows.quote: Please contact your property manager and they can provide you with a receipt. Alternatively, if you have made an online payment, you will be sent an email confirmation and you can also see a record of your payments on the Account Ledger found in the Payments tab.

workflows.label: Utility concierge completion and visible follow-up
workflows.quote: Once the call is complete, you will receive an email confirmation with a summary of the utilities and any home services you set up. The completed utility setup details will be visible in FolioSpace and your property manager will see that your required utilities have been completed.

workflows.label: Resident password change
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Account Profile tab and locate the Password block. Enter your current password, then enter your new password and retype it. Click Save when done. Passwords must be between 8 and 32 characters in length which includes at least one letter and one number or symbol.

workflows.label: Resident Spanish-language account
workflows.quote: You can change the language to Spanish. Click the Account Profile tab on the left, then in the Choose Your Language section use the menu to select Spanish, then click Save.

workflows.label: Resident notice-to-vacate submission
workflows.quote: Your property manager can choose whether or not you can give notice through FolioSpace. If this feature is enabled you can find it on the Contact Us tab. Select Request Notice to Vacate in the Contact Options block. Provide your desired move out date, your reason for leaving, and your forwarding address (if you have it), then click Submit. If your property manager does not offer this feature, you'll need to contact them directly.

workflows.label: Resident email and mobile payment reminders
workflows.quote: Yes, you can set up either email reminders or mobile push notifications if you have the FolioSpace app on your phone. Navigate to the Account Profile tab, then in the Contact Preferences block, select what kind of recurring payment reminders you would like to enable, then click Save.

workflows.label: Preferred-language login and activation
workflows.quote: You can now set your language settings from the FolioSpace login and activation screens on the web. A link on the login screen will allow you to specify whether you prefer Spanish or English, instantly translating the language in view. Upon login, your language is set in the Account Profile. Once the language is set, the next time you navigate to the login page on your device or browser, the language will reflect your preferred setting (provided you have not cleared your cookies).

workflows.label: Resident repair photos and key-entry permission
workflows.quote: Enter a detailed description of the issue, upload one or more photos of the item needing attention (must select multiple photos at once from your computer or camera roll), decide whether or not to give the property manager permission to enter with their key, then click Submit Request.

workflows.label: Resident selection of maintenance availability
workflows.quote: On the next screen, select when a maintenance tech can address your maintenance issue. If you choose to provide preferred times, select three or more time slots, then click Submit.

workflows.label: Repair communication and status timeline
workflows.quote: You can view the high-level status of your maintenance request on the Maintenance tab. The status will range from received, to technician contacted, to technician scheduled, to completed. Select Check Status for a detailed view of all communication sent to you and a status timeline of your request.

workflows.label: Secure resident document delivery notification
workflows.quote: You'll receive an email notification any time your property manager sends you a document securely to your FolioSpace account. Navigate to the Shared Documents tab to access these documents.

workflows.label: Resident executed lease download
workflows.quote: Click Property Details from the menu on the left to view or download your online lease documents.

workflows.label: Resident insurance original upload
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Insurance tab and locate the Upload Renters Insurance Policy block. Enter your insurance company provider, your policy number, policy expiration date, then upload a copy of your proof of insurance. When done, click Submit Policy Information.

workflows.label: Resident insurance policy purchase
workflows.quote: If your property management company has this feature enabled, you can purchase a renters insurance policy directly through FolioSpace when completing your move-in tasks or at any time by navigating to the Home tab and clicking Purchase Renters Insurance to receive an estimate.

workflows.label: Resident insurance policy updates
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Insurance tab to view or update your renters insurance policy.

workflows.label: Liability-to-landlord coverage summary
workflows.quote: If your property management company has added your unit to its Liability to Landlord Insurance, you will see a Notice of Liability to Landlord Insurance link on the Property Details tab. Click this link to view your summary of coverage.

workflows.label: Manager-requested resident account combination
workflows.quote: Only your property manager is capable of combining your FolioSpace accounts, so please contact them directly to make this request. Your accounts must be managed by the same company in order to combine them.

workflows.label: Separately activated multiple rental-unit access
workflows.quote: If you rent multiple units from your property management company and you wish to make payments or details for a different unit, click View Another Unit, then click the button for the unit you wish to view. Each unit must be activated separately, so if you don’t see the unit you’re looking for, contact your property manager.

workflows.label: Authenticated application and cross-device resume
workflows.quote: Your rental application carries a lot of personal information and an account keeps it behind a login you control instead of a link anyone could open. An account also lets you pause and come back on any device without having to start over. You create the account once, before you enter any application details, and it works across all your FolioSpace applications.

workflows.label: Application shared with selected property manager
workflows.quote: The information provided in your rental application is shared only with the property management companies you apply to. Your username and password belong to you.

workflows.label: Single applicant account across applications
workflows.quote: No. One account works for every FolioSpace application, at this property or any other. Sign in with the same email each time.

workflows.label: Application resume ends when vacancy is unavailable
workflows.quote: You can resume and continue an application as long as the property is listed as available. After this, your application will be inaccessible.

workflows.label: Accounting budget forecasts under staff oversight
workflows.quote: Nobody got into this business to spend their evenings entering bills. The Accounting Performer works alongside your accounting team to handle the most time-consuming tasks — coding bills, reconciling accounts, closing the books, and preparing budget forecasts — so your team focuses on the work that actually moves the business.

workflows.label: Corporate reimbursable expense identification
workflows.quote: Catch reimbursable expenses the moment they happen at entry, not at month end

workflows.label: Corporate reimbursement bill payment
workflows.quote: Pay reimbursement bills without leaving AppFolio

workflows.label: Owner portfolio pooled-funds bill payment
workflows.quote: Pay bills against the owner’s full available funds, not under one property at a time

workflows.label: Owner distribution automatic true-up
workflows.quote: Automatic true-up on distributions

workflows.label: Automatic owner property grouping
workflows.quote: Properties group under the same owner automatically

workflows.label: Corporate credit-card statement reconciliation
workflows.quote: Reconcile your statements to ensure accuracy

workflows.label: Maintenance image interpretation and troubleshooting
workflows.quote: Real estate’s only truly agentic AI, the Realm-X Maintenance Performer has the intelligence to reply to residents, analyze images, troubleshoot, prioritize emergencies, and dispatch work to the right technician. Once work is dispatched, you can use automation-driven platform tools to schedule work and bill owners consistently.

workflows.label: Automated emergency prioritization and dispatch
workflows.quote: Real estate’s only truly agentic AI, the Realm-X Maintenance Performer has the intelligence to reply to residents, analyze images, troubleshoot, prioritize emergencies, and dispatch work to the right technician. Once work is dispatched, you can use automation-driven platform tools to schedule work and bill owners consistently.

workflows.label: Resident contact-center maintenance coordination
workflows.quote: Built into the Online Resident Portal and Contact Center, the Maintenance Performer acts as your AI coordinator, responding to residents and dispatching

workflows.label: Maintenance audit filters by staff property date and entity
workflows.quote: Filterable by user, properties, dates, and entities

workflows.label: Service responding and work dispatch
workflows.quote: Your maintenance process plays a key role in keeping residents happy and your teams organized. Ensure residents receive the high-quality service they deserve, while your teams maintain the balance of responding to resident requests, dispatching work orders, scheduling work, and billing effortlessly. Smart Maintenance provides end-to-end, full-cycle support for your residents and for your team on one easy-to-use platform.

Smart Maintenance provides end-to-end, full-cycle support for your residents and for your team on one easy-to-use platform.

Ensure residents receive the high-quality service they deserve, while your teams maintain the balance of responding to resident requests, dispatching work orders, scheduling work, and billing effortlessly. Smart Maintenance provides end-to-end, full-cycle support for your residents and for your team on one easy-to-use platform.

workflows.label: Around-the-clock maintenance response
workflows.quote: Handling maintenance requests around the clock shouldn’t mean your team is on-call 24/7. AppFolio's suite of Smart Maintenance tools helps you stay ahead of resident requests and deliver exceptional experiences, without the overwhelm.
